intro.text: A map of where Anthony Bourdain ate, and a way for strangers to sit down at those places and eat together. Fan-made. Sells nothing.

paragraphs: People everywhere are broadly the same, mostly kind, and everyone has a story worth hearing. That was his idea. This site is built so that idea has somewhere to sit, rather than a paragraph on an About page.

The map is the browsing surface. The table is the point: someone picks a place, sets a date, opens a few seats, strangers take them. After the meal, whoever went writes a short piece about who they met. Not a review — a story.
The first table is in London. Eight seats. Come alone. We will write when the date is set.

Almost every pin comes from a map deannd built on r/AnthonyBourdain over about two years, watching the shows and writing down where he went. Used with permission. Her descriptions appear on the place pages, quoted and credited — they are hers, not the site's voice.
